name: SpireTalk: Living Ancients
author: peiji
description: Talk to the Ancients and the Merchant. Every NPC answers in character on your own API key (OpenRouter / OpenAI / Ollama), remembers you across runs, strikes deals with you, turns up on the road between rooms, hands you a keepsake relic that grows with the relationship, and looks back on your run when it ends. A good relationship can also earn a relic reroll, gold, healing, a potion, a shop discount, or one of the Ancient's own relics on the Merchant's shelf. Works with or without Ancient Affection.
